result.reason: The clause includes the preferred CGL, E&O, cyber, and certificate requirements, but omits workers’ compensation as required by law. It also adds a one-year post-termination coverage obligation not required by the playbook and applies it indiscriminately to all listed policies. The cyber trigger uses “Client Content or Credit Data” rather than the playbook’s broader “Customer Data,” which may leave a coverage gap depending on the definitions. The unrelated force majeure provision is unchanged.
